the screen: x 34, y 72, 123 × 163 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4019 (spec 0.4085), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://www.trustedreviews.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2010/11/14413-views-1.jpg (press render via Koks; open unit cropped)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.trustedreviews.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2010/11/14413-views-1.jpg); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/spiro/).
